hypothesis: A local phase-corrected memory can retain relation knowledge across a reset and use delayed consequences to adapt after unannounced hidden-state interference; compare with exact Bayesian change-point filtering with the same observations.

world.nonbijective_effect_rule: Pre-action effect is fixed code base bit XOR hidden binary state; codes P0 and P2 share base meaning. P2 toggles the latent state for later actions.
world.start_state: New hidden binary initial state for each episode, deterministic from development-only seed; algorithms are told only the two-state possibility.
world.interference: At step 6 of checking episodes, an exogenous hidden state flip may occur; unknown flag is not disclosed to either learner. Exact Bayesian control considers both possibilities.
world.delay: Effect for action at step t is not delivered until t+3. Predictions must precede effect delivery for the current action.

fairness: Same complete development training action/effect stream, same checking action sequence, same delayed checking feedback and public transition structure; no hidden truth or interference bit visible to predictors.
metrics: Pre-feedback per-step effect accuracy, zero credit for abstention
Fit/evaluation CPU/wall, peak memory and serialized state bytes
negative_controls: No feedback must give no justified correct predictions
Inverted sensor must be logged as corrupted-information sensitivity, not a quality improvement
Unannounced switch should expose candidate overconfidence; strong Bayesian control may abstain until evidence arrives
No resetting/checking labels in model fit; no protected first-use
limits: Only three invented source families and twelve steps per episode; same world structure, not unfamiliar-world transfer
Public model class includes exact action toggle structure and known change-point time, so no demonstrated discovery of causal laws
Exact Bayesian control is privileged only to the same publicly disclosed hypothesis family; its unknown hidden state and change flag are not revealed
Energy/FLOPs cannot be claimed unless independently measured
advancement: A tie or loss against exact Bayesian control is a scientific negative. Do not promote a novel causal-learning or Pareto claim from development-only data.
